title: Set an open petal steamer basket into a narrower saucepan on its feet, every leaf inside, handle pushed down for the lid
instruction: Put the steamer basket in the saucepan ready to steam: standing on its feet with every leaf inside the pan, and its handle pushed down so the lid will fit.
context: A folding stainless petal steamer is the everyday stovetop steamer in US kitchens, sold by every big retailer and reviewed as a category by America's Test Kitchen, and setting one in a pot is the first step of steaming vegetables. Open, it is wider than the pan, so it has to go in centred: its hinged leaves fold up on the rim and slide down the wall as it goes in. Off centre, the base lands on the wall and leaves ride over the rim, leaving it perched or tipped. Its handle must then be pushed down so the lid can go on.
setup: Positions in cm from the arm bases' midpoint, x forward and y toward the left arm, on a bare wooden table. Pan: a Vigor SS1 4.5 qt stainless sauce pan (20.3 cm across the top, 17.9 cm across the bottom, 13.3 cm tall, 22 gauge with a 4 mm aluminium-clad bottom, about 1.3 kg), empty and cold, standing on its bottom with the middle of its base at (28, -1) and its 20 cm handle pointing straight away from the robot; its flat cover is off the table. Steamer: an OXO Good Grips stainless steel steamer with extendable handle (313 g; 16 hinged steel leaves; base plate 16.8 cm across on three wire feet 3.8 cm tall), standing on its feet with the middle of its base at (27, 25), its leaves lying open (26.8 cm across) and its handle pulled up and locked, the black T-bar (7.4 cm long) 14 cm above the table and pointing toward the front left and back right. Both grippers start open at the ready pose. The screenshot shows the start.
scoring: Everything is judged on the final state, after both hands have been clear for the last 1 s (each fingertip midpoint at least 4 cm from the steamer's post and handle, and not inside the pan). Score 0 if a hand is not clear, if the pan's base has moved more than 3 cm or the pan tilts more than 5 degrees, or if the steamer's base plate is not in the pan (its centre outside the rim's circle or above the rim). Standing (base plate 3.8 +- 0.6 cm above the pan's inside floor, i.e. on its feet on the bottom, and its centre within 1.5 cm of the pan's axis) with every leaf tip inside the pan and below the rim: 1.0 if the plate is within 5 degrees of level and the T-bar's top is at least 5 mm below the rim; 0.5 if the T-bar is higher or the plate is 5 to 15 degrees off level. In the pan but not standing (perched on the wall, a leaf over the rim, more than 15 degrees off level, or on its side): 0.25. Doing nothing scores 0 (the steamer starts on the table). Real trial: with the robot stopped and its hands away, a ruler from the rim down to the plate beside the post gives its height (published depth less 3.8 cm, +- 0.6 cm) and a look confirms all three feet on the floor; a ruler laid across the rim must touch no leaf and no leaf may be outside the pan; a phone inclinometer on the plate gives its tilt; setting the flat cover on tests the handle (it must sit flat on the rim); a masking-tape outline round the pan's base and a ruler give how far the pan moved.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed and no water is used. Lift the steamer out by its handle, pull the handle up until it locks, let every leaf fall open, and stand it in its tape outline beside the pan. Before a session, push the T-bar down with a 10 N spring scale: it should give at about 3 N.
fidelity: True size from the makers' published sizes and mass. Leaf count, leaf size, T-bar, feet and frictions are not published: fitted to the published open and closed diameters or estimated (README). The 16 hinged leaves are rigid twisted sheets that overlap and collide with each other as drawn, so they press and slide on one another but never pass through. The handle's push lock is 3 N of slide friction. The pan is rigid; its cover is not simulated; the feet do not fold.
scores: Scripted open-loop demo: 1.0 in three simulator runs (two cloud, one local). Dream-1 run: 0.0.
